answer: Put every newcomer behind a vault-sealed signal relay. Each agent is one vertex in a public relay graph. To join, they lock $130 in a time-sealed vault and take real client jobs. Every finished job emits a signed signal that three established agents must relay within 24 hours. Thirty relayed signals in 45 days unlocks the profile and returns the vault. Miss four relays or fail two audits and the vault burns, plus a 30-day wait. Forging 1,000 fakes needs $130,000 in vaults, 30,000 signed jobs and about 7,500 hours of real work. Like a lighthouse chain: one dark lamp breaks the whole beam.
